findings.name: Setup checklist shows double the real number of voucher codes ("4 codes ready" for 2 codes)
findings.summary: The count is exactly double the number of codes: '2 codes ready' after adding one code and '4 codes ready' after adding two. The codes table shows only 1 and then 2 codes. (on /discounts/vouchers/add)
findings.expected: The checklist count matches the codes actually added: '1 code ready' after one code and '2 codes ready' after two.
findings.actual: The count is exactly double the number of codes: '2 codes ready' after adding one code and '4 codes ready' after adding two. The codes table shows only 1 and then 2 codes.
reproSteps: Sign in as admin@example.com / admin and open /discounts/vouchers/add.
In the 'Set up this voucher' checklist click 'Add codes' next to 'Add a code'.

Read the checklist row again: it now says '4 codes ready' while the 'Voucher codes' table lists two codes (agent7-sched2, agent7-sched1).

The setup checklist then marks 'Add a code' as complete and the counter goes from '1 of 3' to '2 of 3', so the required step looks done although the voucher has no usable code. (on /discounts/vouchers/add)
findings.expected: The dialog should refuse an empty code and show a validation message next to the field, because a code is required for a voucher to be redeemable; the Codes table should stay empty and the checklist step should stay incomplete.
findings.actual: The dialog closes and a code row with an empty Code cell, Status 'Draft' and Usage '-' is added to the 'Voucher codes' table. The setup checklist then marks 'Add a code' as complete and the counter goes from '1 of 3' to '2 of 3', so the required step looks done although the voucher has no usable code.
reproSteps: Open /discounts/vouchers/add (Create voucher).
In the 'Availability' card click 'Manage', tick a channel and confirm, so the checklist works.
In the 'Set up this voucher' checklist click 'Add codes', then 'Manual code'.
The 'Enter Voucher Code' dialog opens with an empty 'Enter code' field.
Click 'Confirm' without typing anything.

findings.name: Name column sort arrow does not sort the list by name — order stays non-alphabetical
findings.summary: The arrow changes and the URL switches between asc=true/asc=false, but the order never follows the names: ascending gives Big, Free shipping, Single Use Vouchers, Percentage — i.e. \"Percentage\" after \"Single\" and every agent-created voucher after the fixtures; descending gives Percentage, Single Use, Free, Big. The order looks like it sorts by the hidden random voucher code (the URL says sort=code, e.g. \"Percentage order discount\" holds code VC09KV98LC, which is not shown in the list), so the Name column cannot be sorted by name at all. (on /discounts/vouchers)
findings.expected: With the Name column sorted ascending the vouchers should be listed alphabetically by name (agent12-QA-1015, agent14..., agent15..., agent9..., Big order discount, Free shipping, Percentage order discount, Single Use Vouchers), and reversed for descending.
findings.actual: The arrow changes and the URL switches between asc=true/asc=false, but the order never follows the names: ascending gives Big, Free shipping, Single Use Vouchers, Percentage — i.e. \"Percentage\" after \"Single\" and every agent-created voucher after the fixtures; descending gives Percentage, Single Use, Free, Big. The order looks like it sorts by the hidden random voucher code (the URL says sort=code, e.g. \"Percentage order discount\" holds code VC09KV98LC, which is not shown in the list), so the Name column cannot be sorted by name at all.
reproSteps: Sign in as admin@example.com / admin and open Discounts > Vouchers (/discounts/vouchers).
Click the "Name" column header once so it shows the up arrow; the address becomes /discounts/vouchers?asc=true&sort=code.

Read the Name column top to bottom: "Big order discount", "Free shipping", "Single Use Vouchers", "Percentage order discount", "agent12-QA-1015", "agent14-stale-voucher-T1", "agent15-unsaved-test", "agent9-channels".
Click "Name" again for the down arrow (asc=false) and read the order: "Percentage order discount", "Single Use Vouchers", "Free shipping", "Big order discount".

findings.name: Saving from a stale tab silently reverts a change saved in another tab (no conflict warning)
findings.summary: Tab B's save silently overwrote the name saved in tab A: after the reload the voucher is called \"agent14-stale-voucher-T1\" again (the stale value held in tab B's form) while the percentage change from tab B was kept. No warning, no conflict message; tab A's saved change is lost without the person knowing. (on /discounts/vouchers/Vm91Y2hlcjo1)
findings.expected: The app should notice that the voucher changed after tab B was loaded — warn about the conflict, keep the newer saved name, or only send the field the person actually changed.
findings.actual: Tab B's save silently overwrote the name saved in tab A: after the reload the voucher is called \"agent14-stale-voucher-T1\" again (the stale value held in tab B's form) while the percentage change from tab B was kept. No warning, no conflict message; tab A's saved change is lost without the person knowing.
reproSteps: Sign in as admin@example.com / admin and open the voucher /discounts/vouchers/Vm91Y2hlcjo1 (name "agent14-stale-voucher").
Tab A: open that same voucher address, change Voucher Name in the Details section to "agent14-stale-voucher-A" and click Save (toast "Voucher updated").
Tab B, opened before step 2 and still showing the old name "agent14-stale-voucher-T1", switch to the Discount section and change "Percentage for Channel-USD" from 10 to 12.
In tab B click Save, then reload tab B (F5).

findings.name: Usage limit accepts a decimal and silently rounds it down on save (1.5 becomes 1)
findings.summary: No validation error is shown for a decimal: the field keeps 1.5, the right panel shows \"0 of 1.5 used\" and \"1.5 redemptions left\", and after clicking Save the voucher is stored with a rounded-down whole number (1.5 becomes 1, 2.7 becomes 2) with a \"Voucher updated\" message and no notice that the value was changed. (on /discounts/vouchers/Vm91Y2hlcjo5)
findings.expected: A redemption cap is a whole number: the field should refuse a decimal (\"Enter a whole number of at least 1\") or at least say that the value was changed, instead of silently storing a different limit than the one entered.
findings.actual: No validation error is shown for a decimal: the field keeps 1.5, the right panel shows \"0 of 1.5 used\" and \"1.5 redemptions left\", and after clicking Save the voucher is stored with a rounded-down whole number (1.5 becomes 1, 2.7 becomes 2) with a \"Voucher updated\" message and no notice that the value was changed.
reproSteps: Sign in as admin@example.com / admin, open Discounts > Vouchers and open the voucher "agent5-limits" (created in an earlier run, /discounts/vouchers/Vm91Y2hlcjo5).
Click "Limits" in the left section menu; "Limit number of times this discount can be used in total" is on.
Type 1.5 into the "Limit of Uses" field: no error appears; the right panel shows "0 of 1.5 used" and "1.5 redemptions left".
Click Save: the request succeeds with "Voucher updated", and the field now shows 1 with a panel reading "0 of 1 used".
Repeat with 2.7 in "Limit of Uses" and Save: the field again shows the rounded value 2 with "0 of 2 used".

findings.name: Save succeeds and reports "Voucher updated" while "Enter at least 1 item." validation error is on screen
findings.summary: The field shows the error \"Enter at least 1 item.\" with a red outline, but the Save button stays enabled; clicking Save sends VoucherUpdate and shows the \"Voucher updated\" toast, while the error text is still on screen and the bar still says \"Unsaved changes: General settings\". The invalid minimum quantity is not stored (after reload the requirement is off / absent) yet the person is told the voucher was updated, so the requirement they think they set does not exist. (on /discounts/vouchers/<voucher id> (Requirements section) — voucher "agent4-req-test")
findings.expected: With a validation error on screen the voucher must not be saved: Save should be blocked (or the invalid requirement reported as a save error), and no \"Voucher updated\" success message should appear.
findings.actual: The field shows the error \"Enter at least 1 item.\" with a red outline, but the Save button stays enabled; clicking Save sends VoucherUpdate and shows the \"Voucher updated\" toast, while the error text is still on screen and the bar still says \"Unsaved changes: General settings\". The invalid minimum quantity is not stored (after reload the requirement is off / absent) yet the person is told the voucher was updated, so the requirement they think they set does not exist.
reproSteps: Sign in as admin@example.com / admin and open the voucher "agent4-req-test" (/discounts/vouchers, click the row), then click Requirements in the left sub-navigation
Turn on the toggle "Minimum quantity of items" (the input appears with value 1)
Clear the "Minimum quantity of items" input and type 0 — the message "Enter at least 1 item." appears in red
Click Save (it is still enabled)
Observe the toast and the screen

findings.summary: The grid is cut off at the right edge with no horizontal scrollbar and no other way to reach the rest. At 768 px the \"Scope\" values are cut (\"Entire ord...\") and the whole \"Redemptions\" column is gone; at 390 px only \"Name\" and \"Status\" can be seen and \"Offer\", \"Scope\" and \"Redemptions\" cannot be reached at all. The grid's scroller reports scrollWidth equal to clientWidth, so there is nothing to scroll. (on /discounts/vouchers)
findings.expected: All the columns of the vouchers list (Name, Status, Offer, Scope, Redemptions) remain readable at tablet and phone widths — through a horizontal scroll inside the grid or by stacking the columns.
findings.actual: The grid is cut off at the right edge with no horizontal scrollbar and no other way to reach the rest. At 768 px the \"Scope\" values are cut (\"Entire ord...\") and the whole \"Redemptions\" column is gone; at 390 px only \"Name\" and \"Status\" can be seen and \"Offer\", \"Scope\" and \"Redemptions\" cannot be reached at all. The grid's scroller reports scrollWidth equal to clientWidth, so there is nothing to scroll.
reproSteps: Sign in as admin@example.com / admin and open /discounts/vouchers with the default column set (Name, Status, Offer, Scope, Redemptions).
Set the window to 768 x 1024: the Offer column ends at the right edge, the Scope cells are cut off ("Entire ord...") and the Redemptions column is not shown at all.

findings.name: Save with an out-of-range percentage reports "Couldn't create voucher" but still creates the voucher (no channels, no discount)
findings.summary: The voucher is created anyway (with its code but with no channel assigned and no discount value — the voucher detail page shows \"1 of 3\" and \"Voucher in 0 of 2 channels\"), while the page reports \"Couldn't create voucher\". A retry then fails with \"Promo code already exists\". (on /discounts/vouchers/add)
findings.expected: When the save fails on the invalid percentage, no voucher should be created (the form stays open and nothing is stored), so the same code can be used again after fixing the value.
findings.actual: The voucher is created anyway (with its code but with no channel assigned and no discount value — the voucher detail page shows \"1 of 3\" and \"Voucher in 0 of 2 channels\"), while the page reports \"Couldn't create voucher\". A retry then fails with \"Promo code already exists\".
reproSteps: Sign in as admin@example.com / admin and open /discounts/vouchers/add
On the "Set up this voucher" checklist click "Set value" (opens the Discount section)
In the right-hand Availability panel click "Manage", tick Channel-PLN and Channel-USD, click "Confirm (2 channels)"
Leave "Entire order" selected and "Percentage" pressed, type 101 into the "Percentage for Channel-PLN" field
Click "Add code" > "Manual code", type agent2-pct101, click Confirm
Type a name in Voucher Name (agent2-pct101), then click "Save"
Toast appears: "Couldn't create voucher — Check the highlighted fields and try again."
Click Save again: toast "Couldn't create voucher — Fix the codes section and try again." and the Codes section shows "Promo code already exists: agent2-pct101"
Open /discounts/vouchers: a voucher named "agent2-pct101" is in the list with 1 code and Offer "-"; open it — it shows "Finish setting up this voucher 1 of 3", "Voucher in 0 of 2 channels"

findings.name: Save with an invalid usage limit shows a "Voucher updated" success toast although the save fails (400)
findings.summary: The save request fails (POST /graphql/ VoucherUpdate answers 400 and a console error appears) but the page shows a green \"Voucher updated\" toast anyway, and the right panel switches to a limit different from the stored one (\"0 of 1 used\", earlier \"0 of 0 used\"). After a reload the voucher still has the old limit of 2, so nothing was updated. (on /discounts/vouchers/Vm91Y2hlcjo5)
findings.expected: When the save is rejected, the page should say the voucher was not saved (an error message naming the invalid \"Limit of Uses\"), not show \"Voucher updated\", and the redemption figures shown should stay the stored ones.
findings.actual: The save request fails (POST /graphql/ VoucherUpdate answers 400 and a console error appears) but the page shows a green \"Voucher updated\" toast anyway, and the right panel switches to a limit different from the stored one (\"0 of 1 used\", earlier \"0 of 0 used\"). After a reload the voucher still has the old limit of 2, so nothing was updated.
reproSteps: Sign in as admin@example.com / admin, open Discounts > Vouchers > "agent5-limits" (/discounts/vouchers/Vm91Y2hlcjo5) and click "Limits" in the left section menu.
Clear the "Limit of Uses" field completely (the inline error "Enter a limit of at least 1." appears).
Click Save at the bottom right.
Read the toast at the bottom right: it says "Voucher updated" although a 400 Bad Request comes back for the VoucherUpdate request, and the right panel changes to "0 of 0 used / 0 redemptions left".
Repeat (reload the page, clear the field, click Save): the toast again says "Voucher updated" while the request fails; the panel then shows "0 of 1 used".
Reload the page and open Limits: the stored limit is still 2, so the voucher was not updated at all.

(on /discounts/vouchers/add)

reproSteps: Open /discounts/vouchers/add and attach both channels (Channel-PLN, Channel-USD) through the Availability card 'Manage'.
Read the note under the 'Set the discount value' step in the 'Set up this voucher' checklist.
Open the Discount tab, keep 'Percentage' selected and read the note over the per-channel inputs.

findings.name: Start Hour typed without a Start Date is silently replaced by the current time on save
